desc_zh: 自粘背胶写真材料，1520mm卷宽，120gsm或140gsm底纸，每卷50米。120gsm底纸 USD 13.60/m²；140gsm底纸 USD 14.60/m²。
desc_en: Self-adhesive vinyl in 1520 mm rolls, supplied in 50 m lengths with a 120 gsm or 140 gsm release liner. Reference prices: USD 13.60/m² for 120 gsm liner and USD 14.60/m² for 140 gsm liner.
seo_title_zh: 自粘背胶写真材料批发｜规格、价格与定制印刷｜YINZAOSUO
seo_title_en: Self-Adhesive Vinyl Wholesale | Specs, Pricing & Custom Printing | YINZAOSUO
seo_description_zh: 1520mm宽幅自粘背胶写真材料，每卷50米。120gsm底纸参考价USD 13.60/m²，140gsm底纸USD 14.60/m²。面向印刷贸易商和广告制作商，支持批量采购及国际运输询价。
seo_description_en: Wholesale self-adhesive vinyl in 1520 mm width and 50 m rolls. Choose a 120 gsm or 140 gsm release liner. Reference prices: USD 13.60/m² and USD 14.60/m² respectively. Enquire about bulk orders and international shipping.

detail_zh.lead: 自粘背胶写真材料用于标识、促销及展示画面。已确认规格包括1520mm卷宽、50米卷长，以及120gsm或140gsm底纸。
highlights: 参考价格：120gsm底纸 USD 13.60/m²；140gsm底纸 USD 14.60/m²
默认使用爱普生兼容替代墨水；可选爱普生原装墨水，价格增加USD 5/m²
默认覆100gsm PVC冷裱膜，黄底离型纸；可选亮膜或哑膜
applications: 需要背胶安装的定制画面
finishing: 默认100gsm PVC冷裱膜（黄底离型纸），可选亮膜或哑膜
默认卷装并使用硬质纸筒包装
覆膜材料本身具有高透明、低气味、耐水、耐腐蚀、耐磨、耐刮擦及抗UV等特性；这些描述针对覆膜材料，不代表成品具有未经测试的户外使用寿命。
delivery: 标准包装：卷装，内置硬质纸筒
通常约2天完成生产，工厂备货及发出一般不超过一周
海运运输约40天，实际时效取决于航线、货代及清关
detail_zh.artwork: 请提供印刷文件、成品尺寸、数量、卷装或裁切要求及目的地。生产前可核对文件尺寸和出血设置。
detail_zh.brief: 请提供材料类型、宽度、数量或面积、是否覆膜、油墨选择、包装要求及收货国家/地区。
detail_zh.caveat: 最低起订条件为100平方米，或订单货值超过USD 2,000（满足其中一项即可）。价格为参考单价，运费、税费及最终交付时间需按目的地和运输方案确认。 120gsm和140gsm指底纸克重，不是PVC面膜厚度；面膜厚度及胶水具体性能以工厂最终确认为准。

detail_en.lead: Self-adhesive vinyl for signage, promotional graphics and displays. Confirmed specifications include a 1520 mm roll width, 50 m roll length and a 120 gsm or 140 gsm release liner.
highlights: Reference price: 120gsm liner USD 13.60/m²; 140gsm liner USD 14.60/m²
Epson-compatible replacement ink is standard; original Epson ink is available at an additional USD 5/m²
Standard cold lamination uses 100 gsm PVC film with a yellow release liner; gloss or matte finish available
applications: Custom graphics requiring an adhesive backing
finishing: Standard 100 gsm PVC cold lamination with yellow release liner; gloss or matte finish
Standard roll packing with a rigid paper tube inside

The lamination film itself is described as highly transparent, low-odour, water-resistant, corrosion-resistant, abrasion-resistant, scratch-resistant and UV-resistant. These properties describe the film, not an untested outdoor service life for the finished print.
delivery: Standard roll packing with a rigid paper tube inside
Carton packing can be discussed as an alternative
Production typically takes around 2 days; factory preparation and dispatch generally take no more than one week
Sea freight is approximately 40 days; actual transit depends on route, forwarder and customs arrangements
detail_en.artwork: Please provide print-ready artwork, finished dimensions, quantity, roll or cut-sheet requirements and destination. File dimensions and bleed can be checked before production.
detail_en.brief: Please specify the media type, width, quantity or area, lamination, ink option, packing requirements and destination country or region.
detail_en.caveat: MOQ is 100 m², or an order goods value above USD 2,000; either condition is sufficient. Prices are reference rates. Freight, duties and final delivery dates must be confirmed for the destination and shipping arrangement. The 120 gsm and 140 gsm figures refer to release-liner weight, not PVC face-film thickness. Face-film thickness and specific adhesive performance must be confirmed with the factory.
